facts.text: I am a solicitor and construction lawyer with more than 10 years experience specialising in construction law.
I regularly advise homeowners and builders regarding their contractual and legal rights.
I represent homeowners and builders in NSW, Australia as well as all courts of competent jurisdiction.
I have advised homeowners, builders, and contractors experience regarding latent conditions.
I have advised them on their contract rights, risks and obligations.
I have negotiated and amended contracts to reflect their intentions.
